en.text:
Counts as a "Dealer's Choice" origin trait weapon, but does not benefit from the trait itself.

Precision Hits and collecting Orbs of Power charge up a Golden Gun. Precision Hits grant 16.67% progress, and Orbs of Power grant 8.34% progress. Progress persists through death, and Rally Flags fully charge this perk. 

Hold [Reload] at full charge to cast <yellow 'Cayde's Retribution' /> for 3 shots. Cayde's Retribution lasts 16 seconds and deals 100% increased precision damage to <link Bosses [#CombatantClassifications] />. 

Each Precision Hit with Cayde's Retribution grants 45%|90% increased damage for the 2nd|3rd shot.

Wearing <yellow Celestial Nighthawk /> transforms Cayde's Retribution into a single high-powered shot that deals ~43% more damage than 3 successive precision shots and causes enemies to explode if defeated.

<bold Does not count /> as a super for related effects or buffs.
